classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied addition scaffold and compare each total with 90 and 180 degrees.

content.prompt: Decide whether these angles are complementary, supplementary, or neither.

spec.description: Two open arms descend left and shallowly right from an unnamed upper vertex. The interior is labelled 127°. No arc.
spec.mathematics: Given angle 127°. Source schematic slopes retained; coordinates are drawing positions, not additional givens.

spec.description: Right vertex with two arms extending upper-left and lower-left; 63° inside, without an arc.
spec.mathematics: Given angle 63°; source schematic orientation retained.

answer.worked:
$$127^\circ+63^\circ=190^\circ$$
The sum is neither $90^\circ$ nor $180^\circ$, so the angles are neither complementary nor supplementary.

The sum is $90^\circ$, so the angles are complementary.
